# OverCue Desktop 2.2.67 for Mac

- **DJM-A9:** the SKIP 1/3 & 2/3 Beat FX option is now remembered after the mixer is switched off. Create the A9 update again with the Beat FX values option and install it to get this. A factory reset turns the option OFF.
- **DJM-900NXS2 Stems EQ** is no longer a preview. Testers report it working on real mixers. LOW controls Drums, MID controls Vocals and HIGH controls Harmonics / Other. It needs prepared stems and OverCue CDJ-3000 firmware 1.0.1 or later.
- **Repack existing stems** now skips tracks that are already in the right format, so repacking finishes much faster. The button only appears when the selected USB has stems that need repacking.
- The note about the smaller FLAC stem format now appears only when you plug in a USB that has older stems, instead of after every update. The preparation bar now names the firmware it needs: OverCue firmware 0.10.0 or later.
- The Quality / Fast choice in Settings is now sized to its buttons.
